title: AI in Maritime: Revolutionizing Shipping for Sustainability
description: A guide to AI in maritime shipping — autonomous vessels, route optimisation, emissions tracking, and how intelligent technology is making global shipping more sustainable.
short_description: A no-hype introduction to AI in Maritime, built around real applications, limits, and better judgement.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in Maritime for operators, planners, analysts, product teams, and readers tracking mobility systems.
